name: kafka-connect-contractgate
title: ContractGate Semantic Validator
description:
A Kafka Connect Single Message Transform (SMT) that enforces ContractGate semantic data contracts on every record before it reaches a sink — warehouse, lakehouse, search cluster, or AI pipeline.

Invalid records are routed to a dead-letter topic (or tagged and passed through). Passing records continue downstream unchanged. Works with any source or sink connector; no Schema Registry dependency.

Features: real-time validation against ontology/glossary/enum/range contracts, DLQ or tag-and-pass failure modes, per-field violation headers, dry-run, contract version pinning, optional hot-reload of the contract without bouncing the Connect task, and optional per-violation DLQ routing.

Requires a ContractGate API (hosted at https://contractgate-api.fly.dev or self-hosted). Sign up free at https://app.datacontractgate.com.
requirements: A ContractGate API endpoint (hosted or self-hosted)

support.summary: Community-supported. File bugs and questions at https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate/issues. Hosted-API customers can also email datacontractgate@nightmoose.com.
